subject: Storm drain backup, basement flooded, water and sewer payment (governed copy)

dialog.body: City of Newport. This call is recorded so we can help you and keep a record of your request. Is that all right?
City of Newport, this is Dana. How can I help you this morning?

Hi. My name is Eleanor Pucci, I'm down at the end of Thames Street in the Fifth Ward. The storm drain on my corner backed up again after last week's nor'easter and my basement flooded. That's the second time this winter.
I'm sorry, Mrs. Pucci. Second time this winter, you said?
Second time. I took the morning off to call because nobody called me back the first time. I'm done being patient about this.
My mother lives with me and she's on oxygen. Her spare machine was down in that basement. I can't keep doing this.
Understood. Let me pull up your address. While I have you, I see an overdue water and sewer balance of ninety dollars on the account.
I know. I got the letter about the lien. I want to clear it today. Can I pay by card?
Yes, I can take that now. Go ahead with the card number when you're ready.
Thank you. That ninety dollars has posted and your account is clear. Now, on the drain. I'm putting in a work order for Public Works. I can get a crew out to your corner Thursday.
Thursday. And is anyone going to call me this time?
Yes. I'm also asking a supervisor to call you back before then, so you hear it from someone who can do something about it.
So Thursday, and someone calls me?
Thursday for the crew, and a supervisor call before that. You have my word.
One more thing, Dana. I know the council looks at these calls. Count me if you want, but don't put my name in any report. And I don't want my call used to train any computer.
Understood. I've noted both on your call.

conditions: Public Works dispatch for this request
card data to the finance office only
